title.narrative: National Health Training College Dormitory Activity

description.narrative: Lesotho - HEALTH SECTOR PROJECT - National Health Training College Dormitory Activity: This Program activity will support efforts to increase the number of graduates from nursing and allied health (for example, pharmacy and lab technicians) programs by developing additional dormitories and staff residences at Lesotho's National Health Training College ("NHTC"). Other inputs, discussed in the Health Systems Strengthening Activity section below, will strengthen tutor and mentoring capacities. MCC Funding will support the following: (i) the design and construction of 120 dormitory spaces and 6 apartment residences at the NHTC; (ii) preparation of environmental "Project Briefs"; (iii) implementation of environmental and social mitigation measures; and (iv) furniture, appliances, and furnishings for these new dormitories and staff residences.
National Health Training College, Maseru
